verdict.rationale: Marqeta's velocity controls explicitly enforce spend amount and transaction-count limits over configurable time windows per user, platform-enforced (not app code), and authorization controls further restrict by merchant, complementing per-cardholder caps; this is corroborated by both core docs and the marketing spend-controls summary. Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming daily/monthly/all-time as distinct preset windows and independent (non-Marqeta) confirmation of enforcement behavior.
